newsitem.title: USA: Thermatrix forms venture to treat waste.
newsitem.headline: Thermatrix forms venture to treat waste.

text.p: Thermatrix Inc said it had signed a joint venture with ThermoChem Inc to provide solutions for treating radioactive waste.

Thermatix said the new company, to be called Formatrix, will combine under license patented technologies from each company to create a treatment system to reduce the volume of the radioactive wastes prior to their encapsulation or vitrification for long-term burial.
It said Formatrix will initially focus on treating radioactive wastes from the U.S. Department of Energy and the nuclear power industry, specifically spent on exchange resins.
Based in Columbia, Md, ThermoChem specializes in steam reforming systems.
